_doc: The developer tools made while developing the games, as BrokenDev starts them: 'brokendev.ps1 tools' lists them, 'brokendev.ps1 tool <id> [args...]' starts one against the project's workspace (the LIVE one when it sits beside the repository). Nothing here re-implements a tool: 'run' is the command the tool was always started with. kind: 'server' = a local web UI on its own port (BrokenDev starts it hidden, waits until 'probe' answers, opens 'url' in the default browser; a copy already answering on the port is reused, anything else on the port is reported, never stopped); 'script' = runs once in the foreground (the arguments after the tool id are added to the last step); 'page' = its steps write a page, 'open' is opened in the browser. Placeholders: {root:<name>} (archives.json roots), {python} (a Python 3.10+ with pillow and numpy; 'minPython' asks more), {node}, {bash} (Git Bash), {work} (BROKENDEV_HOME\work\tools\<id>), {home}, {bd}, {repo}. 'env' values are defaults: a variable already set in the caller's environment wins. 'prepare' names a fix BrokenDev applies first (lib\DevTools.ps1). 'from' says where the tool came from. The record of all of this is docs/projects/brokendev-tools.md.

tools.title: VRUN tile editor (CHR pixel art)
tools.edits: the hand-authored art PNGs in src/game/art (player bullet, breakable block, door overlay, spikes, the 8 wire tiles, HUD pieces, title logo...), with speed-tier colour and network previews; a normal build picks the edits up
tools.from: VRUN repository tools/tile_editor (2026-09-04, extended to blocks, doors, spikes, wires); was started by the launch.json entry vrun-tile-editor of the old machine's sys0 root

tools.title: VRUN SFX configurator (which sound plays on which event)
tools.edits: nothing directly: lists every trigger_sfx call site of src/game/main.fab with its current clip, plays the 22 clips rendered by tools/render_sfx_wav.py, and exports your choices as JSON (Copy / Download), which are then applied to main.fab by hand or by Claude, as in August
tools.from: the 'VRUN SFX Configurator' web page of 2026-08-24 (a one-off published page, not in any repository); BrokenDev regenerates the same page from the current game

tools.title: VRUN AudioPlayer configurator (song roster, build, play)
tools.edits: src/audioplayer/roster.json and src/audioplayer/midi/ (upload MIDI files, order and title the songs), builds the AudioPlayer ROM through the shared audio engine (./build.sh audioplayer), plays it in Mesen, downloads the .nes
tools.from: VRUN repository tools/audioplayer_configurator (2026-09-24); was started by the launch.json entry vrun-audioplayer-configurator of the old machine's sys0 root

tools.title: Nested Builder (NES mapper 30 to SNES, Project Nested)
tools.edits: builds a SNES ROM from a .nes (the live VRUN builds are at the top of its list): compatibility, recipe, every Project Nested setting, harvest of entry points, SNES title, NES colours, button remap; writes profiles to m30pipe/games/<crc> only when asked
tools.from: Project-Nested tools/m30pipe/ui (2026-09-24); was started by Nested_VRUN\Nested Builder.cmd (an Edge app window)

tools.title: CTW room template designer + the original CTW game
tools.edits: CTW room templates (sys0/simulations/mz/CTW/rooms/*.xml, the rooms VRUN's map bake reads): browse, paint tiles per layer, save a draft into CTW/dlc/rooms, generate a seeded map and play it in the original CTW (pure-JS launcher, no music in this package)
tools.from: CTW replacement engine tools/replacement-engine/Launch-VRUN.mjs + vrun/designer.html (Start-VRUN-JS.ps1 -OpenDesigner); was the launch.json entry ctw-original (port 8766) of the old machine's sys0 root. Super VRUN's tools/ctw/ctw_serve.py served the same game on the same port

tools.title: VRUN SFX renderer (2A03-accurate WAV of every clip)
tools.edits: nothing: renders the 22 SFX clips to WAV files (default into BrokenDev's work folder; pass --out-dir <folder> for another)
tools.from: VRUN repository tools/render_sfx_wav.py (2026-08-24, the SFX polish pass)

tools.title: VRUN pipe-joint checker (background wire art)
tools.edits: nothing: counts broken pipe joints across every room for the wire tiles (run it after editing wire art in the tile editor; the hand-authored row can fail)

tools.title: VRUN NES colour measurer (palette byte to the RGB Mesen paints)
tools.edits: nothing: forces palette bytes in a real room, screenshots them in Mesen and prints NES_RGB lines for the tile editor (VRUN_RGB_BYTES=05,15,... chooses the bytes)

tools.title: VRUN room warp (screenshot of any room)
tools.edits: nothing: boots the built game in Mesen, warps into room VRUN_TARGET_ROOM (default 32) through the game's own door code and saves warp_room<N>.png in BrokenDev's work folder

tools.title: VRUN room teleport harness (load any rooms for real)
tools.edits: nothing: loads the rooms in VRUN_ROOMS (default: the laser puzzle rooms) through the real room loader, survives them, screenshots each into BrokenDev's work folder

tools.title: VRUN screenshot at a frame
tools.edits: nothing: runs the built game headless and writes a PNG at VRUN_CAPTURE_FRAME (default 60), holding VRUN_CAPTURE_HOLD buttons, to VRUN_CAPTURE_OUT (default capture.png in BrokenDev's work folder)

tools.title: VRUN corruption detector (CHR, nametable, scroll)
tools.edits: nothing: plays the built game (VRUN_DET_INPUT idle|combat, VRUN_DET_FRAMES) and fails on picture corruption; VRUN_DET_INJECT proves it can fail

tools.title: VRUN regression suite (every tools/*_check.lua)
tools.edits: nothing: runs every check of the game against build/vrun_game.nes in Mesen (about 15 minutes; one name, e.g. menu_buttons_check.lua, runs just that one). Known: start_at_option_check fails

tools.title: VRUN laser/mirror puzzle solver
tools.edits: nothing: simulates and solves the laser/mirror puzzle rooms from the baked src/game/map_data.fab (run after changing puzzle rooms)

tools.title: VRUN room reachability check (softlock guard)
tools.edits: nothing: re-derives from the baked src/game/map_data.fab that every enemy marker of every room can be reached or shot (the room-56 softlock class)

tools.title: 6502 disassembler for NESFab ROMs
tools.edits: nothing: dis6502.py ROM.nes PRG_OFFSET_HEX CPU_BASE_HEX COUNT [ROM.mlb], the tool that confirmed the three NESFab miscompiles (offsets from the .mlb)
tools.from: VRUN_Nes_Dev extras/dis6502.py (the VRUN agent's debugging tool, never in the repository)

tools.title: Super VRUN build + headless self-test
tools.edits: nothing: ./build.sh --test (lint, build, then tests/selftest.lua in Mesen; exit 0 = pass)

tools.title: Super VRUN self-play (lag proof)
tools.edits: nothing: tests/run_selfplay.sh plays the built game and fails on any lag frame (MAX_FRAMES, CHECK=1, WARP_ROOM, LOADOUT as in the README)

tools.title: Super VRUN feature check by name
tools.edits: nothing: runs tests/run_<name>_check.sh (door, shadow, hud, portal_shot, twop, transition ...); with no name it lists them
run: if [ -z "$1" ]; then echo 'name a check:'; ls tests/run_*_check.sh | sed -e 's#tests/run_##' -e 's#_check.sh##'; exit 2; fi; exec bash "tests/run_$1_check.sh"

tools.title: Super VRUN negative control by name
tools.edits: nothing: runs tools/negcontrol-<name>.sh, which proves a check fails on a ROM that has the bug (doors, mirror, portal, shadow, soundbank, trail ...); with no name it lists them
run: if [ -z "$1" ]; then echo 'name a negative control:'; ls tools/negcontrol-*.sh | sed -e 's#tools/negcontrol-##' -e 's#.sh$##'; exit 2; fi; exec bash "tools/negcontrol-$1.sh"

tools.title: Super VRUN music modules (MIDI + SoundFont to IT)
tools.edits: audio/*.it, the 11 song modules, rebuilt from VRUN's MIDIs and MNES.sf2 with the per-song arrangement in tools/music/configs/*.json (reports in build/music); then regenerate the soundbank as the script's header says
